title: 253. Palindrome Number

examples.explanation: 121 is identical when read from either end.
The minus sign appears only on one side, so it cannot be a palindrome.
Reversed, the digits form 01, which differs from 10.

hints: Negative numbers are never palindromes; neither are non-zero numbers ending in 0.
Reverse only half the digits and compare with the remaining half (dropping the middle digit for odd lengths) to avoid overflow.
